name: Single-incomer sectionalised switchboard
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Shows one incoming source feeding separately identified bus sections through a section connection.
description: Shows one incoming source feeding separately identified bus sections through a section connection. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “One incomer” at the input and “Sectioned bus supply” at the output. Sectioning alone does not provide source redundancy.
